'This gets +1{d} while defending a weapon attack. / Guardwell'

Identical text to blade_beckoner_boots (Legs) and blade_beckoner_helm (Head); same shape, copied from those drafts / shipped pen/basalt_boots.json.

Guardwell is a printed keyword (printed_keywords) and fires from the card DB keywords field (ability_keywords.guardwell) - deliberately NOT authored here; authoring it again would be a defect.

The +1{d} clause: WHILE_STATIC naming trigger RECALC_DEFENSE + MODIFY_DEFENSE. engine._recalculate_total_defense resets each declared defender to its base {d}, then dispatches RECALC_DEFENSE once per defender to [that defender] + the attack card + both heroes + all permanents/head/chest/arms/legs/weapon zones of BOTH players - arms is in that list, so this equipment receives the dispatch when it defends. Naming the trigger matters: without it the static defaults to RECALC_ATTACK_POWER, where combat.defense_recalc_card is None and MODIFY_DEFENSE falls back to its source card.

IS_DEFENDING_CARD scopes the effect to the defender currently being evaluated (combat.defense_recalc_card is this card, condition_types.py:536-599); without it the once-per-defender dispatch would let this static add +1{d} to every other defending card in turn. MODIFY_DEFENSE writes the defender card's own {d} (effect_types.py:2614-2650), which survives into total_defense; because each pass resets to base first, the static cannot stack across recalculations.

ATTACK_IS_WEAPON reads combat.from_weapon (condition_types.py:198-199), stamped from attack_card.is_weapon when the CombatState is created and consulted at defense-recalc time - the check is on the CURRENT attack being a weapon attack, not on the weapon still sitting on this chain link.
